description: Candidate Intent Taxonomy v1 specification for Trust-Gated Customer Support Agent

intents.definition: Customer reports abnormal battery depletion, sudden percentage drops, overheating while discharging, or power longevity degradation.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions battery life, fast discharge, battery health, overheating while in use, or phone dying quickly.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Inability to charge with a cable/adapter (classify as HARDWARE_CHARGING_POWER_CABLE).

representative_examples.text: I just need @115858 to do something about the battery life because it sucks ass
iOS 11 is killing my battery @115858. Fix it.
@AppleSupport why is my battery life short? I updated to 11.1, my battery is poor. Wife didn’t she likes her battery life
Question- @249 @115858 my iPhone6 dies very quick (have to charge it 3 times a day) my iPhone5 battery was faulty. Could this be the same?
@AppleSupport I’m no expert in battery life  but 40% doesn’t go to 7% in 5minutes

intents.annotation_rule: If battery drain and general software update are both mentioned, assign BATTERY_DRAIN_POWER_CONSUMPTION as primary.
intents.known_ambiguity: Customers frequently conflate battery drain with background app refresh or CPU throttling after updates.

intents.human_readable_name: Device Freeze Crash and Boot Loop
intents.definition: Customer reports system-wide freeze, spontaneous reboot, black screen of death, boot loop on Apple logo, or total device lockup.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Device reboots unexpectedly, becomes totally unresponsive, stuck on Apple logo/spinning gear, or black screen.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Minor interface lag where system still responds (classify as PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY); isolated single-app crash (classify as APP_SPECIFIC_MALFUNCTION).

representative_examples.text: @115858 @AppleSupport y’all really bout to piss me off with this dumbass update. My phone keeps crashing and shutting off
Hey @115858 the new iOS update is garbage and my phone keeps restarting itself. Get your shit together, Carol.
yeah cool, i just love when my phone randomly restarts wtf 🙄 @115858
@AppleSupport my iPhone is a fully up to date so why does my phone keep freezing 🙃???

intents.annotation_rule: Prioritize over PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY if device requires a forced restart.
intents.known_ambiguity: Users use 'freeze' colloquially for both brief 2-second UI pauses and total hardware hard-locks.

intents.definition: Customer reports keyboard malfunction, autocorrect substituting unintended characters (notably the iOS 11 letter 'I' glitch), predictive text failure, or virtual keyboard failing to pop up.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions keyboard, autocorrect, typing glitches, letter 'I' symbol bug, predictive text bar, or dictation.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Hardware physical keyboard failure on MacBook (classify as UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT).

Hello, internet. Can someone explain why this symbol keeps appearing on my phone and when I️ try to type the letter I️? Also @AppleSupport https://t.co/QKwvTLtiN7

intents.annotation_rule: Encompasses both the historical iOS 11.1 letter 'I' glitch and generalized onscreen keyboard glitches.
intents.known_ambiguity: High concentration of near-duplicate tweets during October-November 2017 bug window.

intents.definition: Customer reports general system sluggishness, UI lag, slow app launching, delayed touch responses, or stuttering animations.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions slow phone, lag, sluggish, delayed response, frame drops, stutter, or slow after update.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Hard freeze or crash requiring reboot (classify as DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT).

intents.annotation_rule: Assign when device functions continuously but at noticeably degraded operational speed.

intents.human_readable_name: Network Wifi Bluetooth and Cellular Connectivity
intents.definition: Customer reports failure to connect to Wi-Fi networks, Bluetooth pairing dropping, AirDrop failures, cellular data loss, or 'No Service' status.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular, LTE, 4G, No Service, AirDrop, Personal Hotspot, or dropped calls.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Internet connection working but specific website/app down (classify as APP_SPECIFIC_MALFUNCTION).

representative_examples.text: @AppleSupport still no reliable Bluetooth on my iPhone 8+.

intents.annotation_rule: Assign when communication protocol or wireless radio connection fails.
intents.known_ambiguity: Carrier outages vs Apple device antenna issues.

intents.human_readable_name: Application Specific Malfunction or App Store Bug
intents.definition: Customer reports failure, crash, error, or unexpected behavior in a specific first-party or third-party application.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Names an app (App Store, Safari, Apple Music, Spotify, WhatsApp, Camera, Mail) having an isolated issue.
intents.exclusion_criteria: System-wide reboot or failure affecting all apps (classify as DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT).

representative_examples.text: @AppleSupport Safari keeps crashing over and over today. I deleted ~/Library/Safari to start anew, but the problem persists -  sigh

intents.annotation_rule: App Store download/update errors belong here unless tied to payment method failure.
intents.known_ambiguity: Third-party developer responsibility vs Apple iOS platform bug.

intents.definition: Customer reports unexpected disappearance, deletion, or loss of user content (photos, contacts, notes, text history) and seeks recovery.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Lost contacts, missing photos, deleted notes, text messages disappeared, or failed iCloud restore.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Storage space issues without missing data (classify as PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY or UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT).

intents.annotation_rule: High-urgency customer state; prioritize when content disappearance is the focal grievance.
intents.known_ambiguity: Distinguishing permanent data loss from hidden albums or iCloud sync latency.

intents.human_readable_name: Screen Display, Touch Digitizer, and Biometric Sensor Symptom
intents.definition: Customer reports physical or graphical screen anomalies including dead pixels, vertical lines, flickering, touch digitizer unresponsiveness, ghost touch, or biometric sensor failures (Touch ID, Face ID, Home button sensor).
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions display panel, touch screen unresponsive, ghost touch, screen flickering, colored lines on OLED, cracked glass, Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint scanner, or home button sensor defect.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Software UI lag without digitizer failure (classify as PERFORMANCE_SLOWDOWN_LATENCY); system freeze with black screen and boot loop (classify as DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT).

representative_examples.text: My 6 month old IPhone 6 touch screen is unresponsive. @AppleSupport please help!

@AppleSupport My Touch ID failed when I restarted my phone. Now it’s not working at all
Hello @115858 @AppleSupport what’s happening to my screen https://t.co/GTNXT4VoKd

intents.annotation_rule: Assign when the display panel, touch digitizer, or biometric authentication sensor (Touch ID/Face ID) is the customer's focal hardware symptom.
intents.known_ambiguity: Software-induced touch lag vs damaged physical digitizer or sensor.

intents.human_readable_name: Hardware Charging Cable and Power Accessory
intents.definition: Customer reports inability to charge the device, broken Lightning cable, loose charging port, or wireless charging pad failure.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Device won't charge, loose lightning port, frayed cable, power adapter not recognized, wireless charging failing.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Battery draining while in use (classify as BATTERY_DRAIN_POWER_CONSUMPTION).

representative_examples.text: I swear @115858, this charger is broken in an undetectable way.
Now my phone won't charge.....i see what y'all did @115858

I got my phone yesterday and it’s already not charging thanks @115858 🙃

intents.annotation_rule: Focuses on the power-intake pathway and physical power accessories.
intents.known_ambiguity: Dirty charging port vs dead battery cell.

intents.human_readable_name: Audio Sound Speaker Microphone and Volume Issues
intents.definition: Customer reports physical speaker distortion, receiver inaudibility on calls, microphone transducer failure, headphone jack/mode anomalies, earbud hardware defects, or volume control and settings anomalies (alarm volume, ringer volume, physical volume buttons).
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions speaker, receiver, microphone, mic, sound, AirPods audio, distorted audio, caller cannot hear me, ringer volume, alarm volume, volume buttons, or sound too quiet/loud.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Bluetooth radio failing to pair or connect generally (classify as CONNECTIVITY_WIFI_BLUETOOTH); system-wide iOS freezing during media playback (classify as DEVICE_FREEZE_CRASH_REBOOT).
boundary_cases: Distinguished by acoustic/audio transducer or sound/volume control symptom

intents.annotation_rule: Assign when acoustic transmission (speaker/receiver/mic), audio playback level, or sound/volume control (ringer, alarm, volume buttons) is the customer's primary focal grievance.
intents.known_ambiguity: Software ringer settings vs broken physical volume rocker buttons.

intents.human_readable_name: Account Apple ID Access and Security
intents.definition: Customer reports inability to log into Apple ID, account lockout, two-factor authentication code issues, or forgotten passwords.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions Apple ID locked, forgot password, 2FA code not received, iCloud account disabled.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Billing charge on account (classify as BILLING_CHARGE_REFUND_DISPUTE).

intents.known_ambiguity: Device passcode lock vs cloud Apple ID password lock.

intents.human_readable_name: Billing Charge Refund and Subscription Dispute
intents.definition: Customer reports unexpected credit card charges, iTunes Store purchase disputes, subscription cancellations, or refund requests.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions unexpected charge, refund, cancel Apple Music subscription, charged twice, iTunes receipt.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Hardware repair cost estimate question (classify as UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT).

intents.annotation_rule: Applies whenever money, financial transactions, or recurring subscriptions are contested.
intents.known_ambiguity: Bank pending hold vs final settled charge.

intents.definition: Customer inquires about Apple Online Store order status, delivery dates, courier tracking (UPS/FedEx), or in-store pickup reservations.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions order number, shipping date, delivery delay, tracking UPS, iPhone X preorder delivery.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Billing dispute after receiving product (classify as BILLING_CHARGE_REFUND_DISPUTE).

intents.definition: Customer reports suspicious email, phishing SMS text message claiming to be Apple, account compromise alert, or malware/scam inquiry.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions phishing, suspicious text, fake Apple email, scam, hacked, or asks 'is this email real'.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Forgotten password on real account (classify as ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ACCESS).

intents.human_readable_name: Unknown, Insufficient Context, or Out-of-Scope Content
intents.definition: Messages containing no actionable technical diagnostic symptom, comprising Category A (commercial marketing spam, keynote broadcast retweets, bot promotions, non-support commentary) and Category B (genuine customer inquiries directed to AppleSupport with zero diagnostic symptom, bare help cries, bare greetings/pings, image-only links, or pure symptomless frustration rants).
intents.inclusion_criteria: Commercial keynote/event marketing retweets, bot giveaway spam, bare help cries ('help', 'please help me'), conversational greetings/pings ('hello?'), image links with no textual symptom, or pure symptomless emotional venting ('this update sucks', 'fix your phone').
intents.exclusion_criteria: Any inquiry identifying a technical symptom, component, or failure mode even if tersely or colloquially phrased (e.g. 'battery dying', 'screen unresponsive', 'phone is slow', 'update failed', 'letter I bug'). Must be classified into diagnostic Intents 1–14.
boundary_cases: Strict separation between non-diagnostic/out-of-scope contacts and vague but classifiable diagnostic complaints
